title: 马尔杜克与提亚马特的战争
summary: 原初神族的冲突使提亚马特组织军队，马尔杜克则以胜利后拥有最高权威为条件迎战。他用风与箭杀死海神，整理宇宙并安排人类劳役，巴比伦神的地位由此确立。
paragraphs: 巴比伦《埃努玛埃利什》中，年轻众神的喧闹引发原初神族冲突。提亚马特起初反对毁灭后代，后来在阿普苏被埃阿杀死以及新的纷争之后，转而组织可怕的军队。她把命运之板交给统帅金古，众神不敢迎战；马尔杜克于是提出条件，若自己取胜，众神必须承认他的最高号令。
神会确认马尔杜克的权力，他备好弓箭、网与诸风，驾车迎向提亚马特。交战时，他用网罩住她，把恶风送入她张开的嘴里，使她无法合口，随后以箭射穿身体，杀死这位对手。他又制服她的军队，取走金古持有的命运之板，原先压倒众神的联盟因此瓦解，胜者开始支配战后安排。
马尔杜克把提亚马特的身体剖开，以其中一半架成天空，设置守卫约束水域，又安排星辰与历法。金古后来被处死，埃阿依照计划用他的血创造人类，让人承担供养诸神的劳役。众神修建巴比伦并赞颂马尔杜克的名号；这篇创世诗同时确立神的等级，不只是勇士消灭一头怪兽。

en.title: Marduk’s War Against Tiamat
en.summary: Conflict among the first generations of gods brings Tiamat’s army against younger divinities. Marduk accepts battle in exchange for supreme authority. His victory establishes cosmic arrangements and humanity’s labor, while the poem exalts Babylon and its god within a divine hierarchy.
paragraphs: In the Babylonian Enuma Elish, noisy younger gods provoke conflict among the primordial powers. Tiamat initially opposes destroying her descendants, but after Ea kills Apsu and further disputes arise, she assembles a terrifying army. She gives its commander, Qingu, the Tablet of Destinies. Marduk offers to fight only if victory will establish his commands as supreme among the assembled gods.

The divine assembly confirms his authority. Armed with bow, net, and winds, Marduk rides against Tiamat. He encloses her in the net and drives an evil wind into her open mouth, preventing it from closing. An arrow pierces her body and kills her. He then captures her forces and removes the Tablet of Destinies from Qingu, breaking the opposing coalition.

Marduk divides Tiamat’s body, setting up one half as heaven and stationing guards to restrain its waters. He orders stars and the calendar. Qingu is executed, and Ea uses his blood to fashion humans who will perform the gods’ labor. The gods build Babylon and praise Marduk’s names. Creation here establishes divine hierarchy as well as defeating a formidable opponent.

title: 恩基为世界安排职掌
summary: 恩基巡视大地，使河流田野获得供养，并把耕作、牧养与纺织分派给不同神明。伊南娜见诸神各有职责，前来质问自己的位置，恩基便列举她已有的力量回应抱怨。
paragraphs: 苏美尔诗《恩基与世界秩序》并不从空无讲起，而是让已经拥有神权的恩基巡视大地，确认城邦、山野与海域的命运。他赞颂苏美尔与乌尔，为土地安排繁盛，也让河流水量丰盈。世界的问题不是还没有天地，而是河渠怎样通水、牲畜怎样养活、诸神各自负责什么。
恩基把具体事务逐项交付：有人照看河流与灌溉，有人掌管农田与谷物，牧神管理牲畜，杜穆兹照料羊圈牛栏，使诸神的餐桌获得乳脂与食物。他又安排边界、城邑和田地，把纺织交给乌图女神。分工从流水一直延伸到衣物，神圣秩序因而落实在人们每天从事的生产活动中。
伊南娜却哭着来到恩基面前，列举姐妹们掌握的接生、书写与渔业，质问为何自己没有职掌。恩基回应她，指出她已经拥有装饰、男女生活以及扰动战场的力量，并非被排除在秩序之外。诗末虽有缺行，仍以赞颂恩基收束；这里没有另篇伊南娜与恩基故事中酒后运走神力的情节。

en.title: Enki Assigns the World Its Duties
en.summary: Enki travels through an existing world, supplying waterways and assigning divine responsibility for farming, herding, and weaving. Inanna complains that other goddesses have received defined functions while she has not. His answer recalls her established powers rather than inventing another landscape.
paragraphs: The Sumerian poem Enki and the World Order does not begin with an empty universe. Enki already holds divine authority when he surveys lands, cities, and waters and determines their fortunes. He blesses Sumer and Ur and makes the rivers abundant. The task is to organize an inhabited world: channels need water, animals need care, and divine responsibilities need definition.

Enki assigns oversight of waterways, agriculture, and grain, while pastoral divinities supervise wild and domestic animals. Dumuzi’s sheepfolds and cattle pens supply rich food for divine tables. Boundaries, cities, and fields receive their places, and the goddess Uttu receives responsibility for textile work. From flowing water to finished clothing, the poem locates sacred organization within the practical activities that sustain human communities.

Inanna approaches Enki in tears, naming the functions her sisters have received in childbirth, writing, and fisheries. Where, she asks, are her own duties? Enki answers by listing her existing powers over adornment, relations between the sexes, and upheaval in battle. Although the closing passage is damaged, the poem ends in praise of Enki, not with another tale’s removal of divine powers.
